basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old digital marketing consultant based in Portland, Oregon. During the weekdays, I help small businesses establish their online presence. On weekends, I enjoy diving into the world of augmented reality games like Wizards Unite. I recently started exploring shamanism and enjoy sharing experiences with like-minded individuals. Though I'm single, I enjoy social gatherings and often hang out at local cafes. My typical online hours are late evenings, where I unwind by browsing through various Reddit threads.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Business Administration and have been working in the digital marketing space for over 5 years. My interest in augmented reality games stems from my love for technology and innovative gaming experiences. Recently, I've been self-studying shamanism, attending workshops, and engaging with communities to expand my understanding.
